headline: Lending accelerates in the Republic of Moldova. Banks financed the economy with 7.24 billion lei in August - Forbes.ro
summary: Banks in Moldova financed the economy with 7.24 billion lei in August, with lending accelerating according to the report.
why: Credit growth is a leading indicator of domestic demand and investment, and it shapes the earnings outlook for local banks.
